description: This file defines a static utility class SegmentBuilder for encoding and decoding data into ArraySegments, mainly used for efficient serialization in streaming contexts.

classes.name: SegmentBuilder
classes.description: A utility static class providing methods to estimate size, append, and read data (bytes and strings) from ArraySegments.

methods.name: CalculateAppendSize
methods.description: Calculates the space needed to append a given byte span or string into a segment.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends bytes or strings to a specified ArraySegment at a given offset.

methods.name: ReadNextBytes
methods.description: Reads a byte array segment from an ArraySegment based on size prefix.

methods.name: ReadNextString
methods.description: Reads a string from an ArraySegment based on size prefix, handling null and empty strings.
